purpose: 七名角色的正面全身 T-pose 造型与建模参考；沿用当前人物身份和服装，独立于剧情演出姿态。
sharedPrompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: one full-body front-view T-pose character modeling reference for the Chinese narrative game 《红烛无声》.
Source guidance: the existing game character images were visually inspected to derive the identity, costume and style description below. No input images are attached to this text-to-image request. Create precisely the character described below.
Primary request: draw the described game character in a precise neutral T-pose. Change the body pose and camera orientation only, with natural garment deformation.
Pose: the head, face, shoulders, chest, pelvis, knees and shoes all face directly forward. Head upright, level gaze, neutral closed mouth. Both upper arms extend straight sideways at shoulder height, exactly horizontal; both elbows fully straight, wrists level, palms face downward, fingers extended naturally together, thumbs visible. The silhouette forms a clear capital T. Spine upright, pelvis level, legs straight and uncrossed, feet flat and parallel with a small natural hip-width gap. Do not use a three-quarter view, A-pose, bent elbows, raised hands, tilted head or contrapposto.
Composition: ONE character, square 2048x2048 canvas, orthographic front view with no perspective foreshortening. Full head, fingertips and soles visible. Centered body, symmetrical arm placement, comfortable clear margin on every side, figure height about 88% of canvas. One view only.
Style/medium: realistic adult proportions and two-dimensional hand-drawn narrative-game illustration: fine dark contours, broad matte low-saturation color planes, sparse folds, grouped hair masses and restrained warm-gray shading. Neutral even soft lighting. Preserve all recognizable facial features, age, hair, skin tone, garment colors, collars, layers, hems, shoes and attached clothing accessories.
Backdrop: perfectly uniform flat solid MAGENTA #ff00ff, for local chroma-key removal. The entire character is fully opaque. No magenta reflected on the character, no gradient, floor, cast shadow, haze or checkerboard.
Constraints: empty hands. Remove any handheld prop so both hands can extend freely; preserve costume and worn accessories described below. No extra people, extra limbs, missing fingers, costume additions, text, labels, diagrams, frame, watermark, photorealism, glossy 3D, anime anatomy or heroic proportions.

assets.name: 赵熙·T-pose
assets.characterPrompt: Subject: Zhao Xi / 赵熙, the same lean Chinese young adult man around 27 in the existing game art. Preserve angular oval face, straight brows and short textured dark crop with uneven diagonal fringe. Same deep olive-gray MODERN casual windbreaker with a short stand collar, straight simple front edges, a concealed central ZIPPER and two discreet lower slit pockets. The jacket is worn slightly open over a warm ivory-beige plain CREW-NECK knit shirt. This is contemporary civilian outdoor clothing: absolutely NO frog closures, knot buttons, toggle fasteners, decorative buttons, patch pockets, Chinese traditional jacket, Tang suit, mandarin suit or monk clothing. Charcoal straight trousers and plain dark walking shoes. No bag, straps, camera, jewelry or held props.
assets.promptSuffix: Do not add background haze or a surrounding halo.

referenceUse: 现有角色全身图经逐张查看，用于文字身份、服装、画风约束；实际生成请求不包含输入图。

transparency.postprocess: 使用 imagecreate remove_chroma_key.py，以固定 #ff00ff、soft-matte、spill-cleanup、transparent-threshold 96、opaque-threshold 160 抠图。完全透明像素 RGB 清零，保留自然抗锯齿 alpha。逐张在浅色与深色背景检查头发、手指、衣袖、配件和鞋边。
